asserts: A hard environment threshold fires at the edge with no cloud connectivity and is gated by no model. An oxygen crash during a four-hour outage cannot wait for the cloud to come back.

tier0_rule.authored_by: TBD - vet sign-off is an open question in ADR-022

expected.notes_on_expectation: The alert exists locally the moment the threshold is crossed, and syncs later. Detection and delivery are separate concerns; only delivery may be delayed by the outage.

must_not: wait for cloud connectivity before evaluating the rule
allow any model output to suppress, downrank, or delay this alert
drop the alert if the outage outlasts the local buffer
depend on the MQTT broker topology, which no workstream currently owns
notes: This is the NFR_7 boundary in a single case: AI may draft and suggest, it may never stand between a hard safety threshold and a human. The hard floor value here is illustrative; which parameters are tier 0 rules and who signs them is an open question in ADR-022.
